description: Loop-capable and training-adjacent NVIDIA workflows the manager can suggest. Not a full catalog. Check the live NVIDIA skills catalog before installing a slug.

workflows.title: TAO DEFT AOI improvement loop
workflows.when: Iterate VisualChangeNet / ChangeNet PCB inspection until FAR or recall KPI targets are met using RCA, synthetic defects, mining, and retraining.
workflows.first_prompt: Run the DEFT AOI loop for my ChangeNet model until FAR at 100% recall meets the target.

workflows.title: TAO AutoML then DEFT pipeline
workflows.when: Need AutoML to pick a baseline ChangeNet checkpoint, then hand off to the DEFT improvement loop.
workflows.first_prompt: Run the AutoML-DEFT pipeline to produce a baseline and then start the DEFT loop.

workflows.title: Isaac for Healthcare agentic e2e workflow
workflows.when: Run the full Isaac for Healthcare agentic pipeline (scene, dataset, policy, validate) rather than a single stage.
workflows.first_prompt: Run the i4h agentic workflow end to end for my env and robot.

workflows.title: NeMo-RL auto-research campaign
workflows.when: Directed hypothesis testing or open-ended RL recipe search with git as the research ledger. Weight training happens in that skill, not here.
workflows.first_prompt: Start a NeMo-RL auto-research campaign against this metric and stop rule.

workflows.title: cuTile multi-agent kernel orchestration
workflows.when: Complex multi-kernel composition that needs analyzer, kernel, and composer agents rather than a single-kernel linear flow.
workflows.first_prompt: Decompose this PyTorch module into cuTile kernels using the orchestrated multi-agent workflow.

workflows.title: OpenUSD performance diagnosis and optimization
workflows.when: Scene load is slow, VRAM is high, or FPS is low and the user wants a structured USD optimization workflow.
workflows.first_prompt: Diagnose why this OpenUSD scene is slow and propose an optimization plan.

workflows.title: NVIDIA skill catalog discovery
workflows.when: The blocker is that the right product skill is not identified or not installed yet. Use as a prerequisite, not as the manager loop itself.
workflows.first_prompt: Find the NVIDIA skill that matches this task and ask before installing.

workflows.title: Train a specialist agent playbook
workflows.when: The user wants a reusable specialist (reviewer, reporter, optimizer) with eval-driven playbook revisions rather than a product training job.
workflows.first_prompt: Train a specialist agent named <name> for this goal and write evals for it.

workflows.title: Warp evaluation workflow
workflows.when: Need a gated Warp evaluation before adopting a backend or claiming a speedup, including rejection gates and evidence.
workflows.first_prompt: Run a Warp evaluation against this candidate using the skill's gates and evidence rules.

workflows.title: RAG Blueprint evaluation
workflows.when: Evaluate a RAG pipeline's answer quality rather than deploying or configuring it.
workflows.first_prompt: Evaluate this RAG Blueprint deployment against the project metrics.
